items.t: Exchange Traded Concepts and Kiwoom Securities (USA) Launch KICK Space Data Center & Infrastructure Index ETF (Nasdaq: SDC)
items.sum: Exchange Traded Concepts, LLC ("ETC") and Kiwoom Securities (USA) Inc. today announced the launch of the KICK Space Data Center & Infrastructure Index ETF (Nasdaq: SDC), the second fund in the KICK ETFs lineup. SDC joins the KICK Korea Semiconductor Index ETF (NYSE Arca: KCHP), which began trading on September 15, 2026.
